description: Complete native Android app build-out for Des Moines Insider, mirroring the existing iOS SwiftUI app feature-for-feature. Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and MVVM architecture. Integrates with the existing Supabase backend, Google Play Billing for subscriptions, Google Maps for map features, and Firebase for push notifications. The app includes: 6-tab navigation (Home, Dining, Search, Map, Saved, Profile), event/restaurant/attraction discovery with full-text search, premium subscription tiers (Free/Insider/VIP), offline caching, onboarding, authentication (email + Google Sign-In), deep linking, and accessibility compliance.
